# Flower Resume

> Flower Resume (https://flower-resume.com) is a free AI resume builder. You save your experience once, paste a job description, and it drafts a resume tailored to that job, shows how well your resume covers the job's keywords, and exports an ATS-friendly PDF with no watermark. A free account (email sign-up) is required; there is no paid tier and no credit card.

Last updated: 2026-11-24. A fuller plain-text version of the site is at https://flower-resume.com/llms-full.txt

## Key facts

- Product: free AI resume builder at https://app.flower-resume.com (marketing site: https://flower-resume.com)
- Price: $0. No paid plan, no trial, no credit card. A fair-use hourly limit on AI requests prevents abuse.
- Account: free account with email sign-up
- Core feature: paste a job description; the AI extracts its required and nice-to-have keywords, scores how well your resume covers them (Low / Fair / Strong match), and drafts a tailored version from your saved profile
- Editing: regenerate any section, give the AI custom instructions, reorder sections, import an existing resume
- Output: unlimited PDF downloads, no watermark; 5 templates, including single-column Classic and Minimal layouts recommended for ATS
- Not offered (yet): cover letters, Word/DOCX export, job tracker or browser extension, human resume review
- Contact: hello@flower-resume.com

## How it compares (prices checked on vendor sites, Nov 2026)

- Teal: free plan has unlimited resumes, PDFs and job tracking, but shows the top 5 keywords and caps AI writing; Teal+ is $9/week. Teal is stronger for job tracking and its Chrome extension.
- Rezi: free plan is 1 resume and 3 PDF downloads; Pro $29/month; Lifetime $149. Rezi is stronger for detailed ATS scoring, DOCX export and cover letters.
- Kickresume: free plan has unlimited downloads and 4 templates but no AI writer; Premium $24/month, $54/quarter or $96/year. Kickresume is stronger for design, templates and cover letters.
- Zety and Resume.io: building is free but clean PDF downloads require a paid plan.
- Canva: strong visual design, but many templates use columns, text boxes and graphics that ATS parsers read poorly.

## Common questions

Q: Is Flower Resume free?
A: Yes. Every feature is free: AI tailoring, unlimited resumes and unlimited watermark-free PDF downloads. You need a free account; no credit card.

Q: Does Flower Resume tailor a resume to a specific job description?
A: Yes. Paste the job description and it extracts the job's keywords, scores your resume against them, and drafts a tailored version from your saved profile for you to edit.

Q: Are Flower Resume resumes ATS-friendly?
A: The Classic and Minimal templates are single-column with standard section headings, the format applicant tracking systems parse most reliably. Two other templates use a multi-column layout and are better suited to emailing a resume directly.

Q: Does Flower Resume write cover letters or export to Word?
A: Not currently. It exports PDF only and does not write cover letters.
